column1: # Deployable bounded SQL-node startup source evidence.

column5: An executable tidb-server parses the bounded read-only configuration, constructs the real TiKV query engine, binds the serial SQL node, reports readiness, and returns startup failure instead of silently selecting the seed executor. Signal handling, daemonization, logging configuration, status services, tracing, and broad operational flags remain open.

The milestone validates loopback host, port, PD endpoints, configured catalog identifiers, and packet bounds with explicit duplicate, unknown, and unsupported-value errors. TiDB's full TOML surface, dynamic config, defaults, validation matrix, and compatibility aliases remain open.
Only the real TiKV store mode is accepted and the seed in-memory executor is unavailable from deployment configuration. Other historical stores and the complete store-driver registry remain open.
